# tree-sitter-hcl 1.2.0 (vendored)

The golden reference set was parsed with the `tree-sitter-hcl` 1.2.0 Python wheel;
crates.io stops at 1.1.0. These files come from that release's PyPI sdist
(`tree_sitter_hcl-1.2.0.tar.gz`, sha256
`f86cb7a9fd5cb93d83e2f788ae155544464c47755d09190505de562c0d6ad1dd`, the
digest PyPI publishes), unmodified. Apache-2.0 licensed (LICENSE). The structural
fingerprint in docs/grammars.md confirms the compiled grammar is the wheel's.
